draft_notes.explanation: Learn the cleared edge from all four visible edge hypotheses using exact demonstration outputs. Flood every non-wall cell reachable from that edge and clear it; paint every remaining non-wall region with the unique scatter colour. Require all surviving hypotheses to agree on query. Factory ignores d4 and rejects missing or multiple scatter colours, absent/no-fit demos and ambiguous query predictions. No fallback to an augmentation-derived edge or arbitrary colour.
draft_notes.mechanism_proof: Every native column has a contiguous one/two-cell barrier run, or is clipped entirely below the board. Consecutive drawn cells differ by at most1row, including tile joins. Adjacent barrier intervals therefore overlap or diagonally touch, preventing any four-neighbour crossing between above/below sets. Each nonempty above segment reaches the top. A wholly bottom-clipped column has no below segment, and adjacent visible runs reach the bottom. Hence the native directional per-column fill equals all components not touching the cleared top edge, including multiple sealed pockets. Top clipping is rejected by the constructor.
